# Forgejo 16.0.3 recordings

Generated by [record.py](../../record.py). Each file contains the request body and complete response body, with secrets and email values redacted and URL origins normalized to `http://127.0.0.1`. Headers and browser cookies are never recorded. Array order, IDs, commit IDs, and timestamps are preserved. A null response body means an empty HTTP body. Setup and Git operations are described in the [runbook](../../README.md).
